summary: By default a vault ID label is only a hint and Ansible tries the given password on all content; setting DEFAULT_VAULT_ID_MATCH makes each password decrypt only content with a matching label, though it still does not enforce one password per label.
questions: How do I make Ansible only use a vault password for content with a matching vault ID?
Does Ansible check that the vault ID in a file matches the one I pass?

answer_card.title: Enforce vault ID matching
answer_card.answer_md:
By default the label is just a hint: Ansible tries the password you supply on all encrypted content. Set the config option **`DEFAULT_VAULT_ID_MATCH`** so each password is used only for data encrypted with the same label. This is more predictable and reduces errors.

Even with it enabled, Ansible still doesn't enforce that a label always maps to the same password.
